lines.text: We have fiber splice histories and cable run data in CSV spreadsheets.
We can handle the CSV migration within thirty days of contract signature.
Can field crews scan optical fiber equipment barcodes with their cameras?
Our tablet app supports barcode scanning out of the box on iOS.
Can we generate batch PDF export invoices for municipal clients?
We could probably support batch PDF invoices, let me follow up with engineering.
We will provide our route fiber maps by Friday afternoon.
